# tonal

> Tools for music analysis and generation


## Pages in this subsection

- [tonal](tonal.html.md): Tools to generate music
- [tonal.chords](tonal.chords.html.md): Tools for chords and chord progressions.
- [tonal.converters](tonal.converters.html.md): Convert music into various formats.
- [tonal.counterpoint](tonal.counterpoint.html.md): Tools for counterpoint.
- [tonal.notes](tonal.notes.html.md): Notes, scales, and chords definitions.
- [tonal.util](tonal.util.html.md): Utils for sonification.
